Subject: RAG pilot — technical qualification & next milestones

Hi Susan & Peter — great session today, thanks for the time. Quick recap + proposed technical next steps so we’re aligned before the pilot kick-off.

Highlights from the call
- Primary goal: authoritative answer experience for customer support KB (50k docs, mixed PDFs + HTML).
- Success criteria (initial): recall@10 >= 0.85, precision@5 >= 0.70, grounding-precision >= 0.75, hallucination rate < 3% on evaluation set.

Redwood recommended baseline (for the qualification run)
- Retrieval: chunk size 400–600 tokens, 100-token overlap for context continuity. Vector index: HNSW (faiss-backed) with L2. Fresh upsert cadence weekly for KB.
- Embeddings: redwood-embed-2k (512 dims) for semantic recall; recommend reindexing sample set during the pilot.
- Reranker: cross-encoder style re-ranker (small cross) for top-20 re-rank, aiming for higher precision at cost of a small latency bump. If latency is constrained, use bi-encoder candidate pruning + lightweight cross re-rank on top-5.
- Model stack for generation: redwood-chat-7b-q4 for fast prod-like latency; redwood-chat-13b-int8 for quality-sensitive regressions. We recommend running both in parallel for A/B before committing to quantized 13B.

Evaluation artifacts we will provide / run
- Prompt sets: "Support-FAQ-1000" (1000 curated Q/A), "Escalations-200" (hard grounding cases), and a blind test set from your anonymized transcripts.
- Benchmarks: we’ll run retrieval-only (recall@10), reranker precision@5, and end-to-end grounding precision. Link to initial benchmark template below.

Risks we flagged on call
- Quantization regressions: some entity hallucination spikes observed when moving 13B to int8 without calibration. We’ll include regression checks during canary.
- Reranker latency: cross-encoder increases p50 by ~60–90ms on CPU fallback; need to test on sample infra.

Next steps (proposed timeline)
- Today: we’ll upload an eval harness + prompt set template to the Drive (attached).
- By Tue Jan 12: Redwood provides a short run on a 10k-doc subset with both reranker configs + embedding vectorizer and shares baseline metrics. (Owner: Marissa)
- By Thu Jan 14: Technical deep dive (60 min) to validate infra, latency SLOs, and finalize acceptance criteria. Please pick a slot: https://calendar.redwood.com/tessa/30min (Owner: Tessa)
- Week of Jan 18: Pilot deploy (canary) on your staging with monitoring hooks + automatic fallback to smaller model if regression detected.

Attachments: ecovia_prod_sample_20270108.csv (sample docs), MAP-ecovia-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan template).

Appreciate any clarifying questions — happy to adjust chunking/re-ranker tradeoffs depending on your latency targets.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference

Hi Susan — answers inline and a short plan. Attaching detailed benchmark PDF (redwood_reranker_benchmarks_q1_2027.pdf).

1) Reranker latency — expectation
- Cross-encoder (GPU): p50 ~45ms, p95 ~120–160ms per candidate on a T4-equivalent. For top-20 re-rank that maps to ~600–900ms, but with optimized batching and pruning we expect to hit p95 ~420–550ms on our staging shape. If you need sub-400ms p95 we recommend bi-encoder + light cross re-rank on top-5 which reduces p95 to ~280–360ms.

2) Embedding footprint
- 50k docs x 512 dims x 4 bytes ≈ 100MB raw vectors + index overhead (~2–3x) => plan for ~300MB. We’ll size initial staging index at 1GB to be safe.

3) Blind test data
- Sanitized Q/A is perfect. Please also include a small subset of source doc ids so we can compute grounding-precision.

Planned run (Marissa -> owner)
- Today (12 Jan): I’ll run the sample 10k subset and upload a short results CSV + the endpoint logs.
- Wed 13 Jan: Run two reranker configurations (cross-encoder top-20, bi-encoder + top-5 cross) and share metrics: recall@10, precision@5, grounding-precision@5, hallucination rate.
- Thu 14 Jan: We’ll provide a short canary playbook for the pilot deploy (alerts, automatic rollback thresholds).

Mutual Action Plan (short)
- Redwood: baseline runs on 10k subset (due 12 Jan) — Marissa
- Ecovia: sanitized 2k blind Q set + confirm staging sizing (due 13 Jan) — Susan
- Joint: technical deep dive (pick slot) — Tessa
